selection_process: Candidates who successfully apply for the notified posts will be called for an Objective Type (Multiple Choice Question

MCQ) written examination. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the written examination. There will be negative marking in this written examination: each question carries 1 mark
and ¼ mark will be deducted for a wrong answer. In case of a tie in merit in the written examination: first
the candidate with the higher age (based on date of birth) will rank above; if the date of birth is also the same
the candidate with a higher percentage in the required educational qualification will rank above; if this is also tied
the candidate with higher marks in Matriculation will rank above. Based on the merit list
candidates will be called for counseling for verification of all documents. The number of candidates called for counseling will be decided by the Board or its competent authority/officer
keeping in view the category-wise number of vacancies. After counseling

the names of candidates found completely successful/eligible will be recommended to the concerned department as per the then-current number of vacancies (which may be reduced or increased at any time during the recruitment process as per the concerned department's orders/instructions). Applying online
having one's name in the merit list

or being called for counseling does not by itself entitle a candidate to be recommended for a post. Only after the candidate's eligibility is proved in every respect will their name be recommended to the department on the basis of merit in the written examination. If a candidate is unable to prove their eligibility
and the Board's decision in this regard will be final. Candidates called for counseling will be considered only under the category/post code against which they applied.
how_to_apply: Candidates can apply only online, by clicking the link under "Apply Online" on the Board's website https://sssb.punjab.gov.in, from 01-10-2026 to 22-10-2026. Applications received through any other method will not be accepted and will be considered rejected.

Registration and Login: Candidates who do not have a Login/User ID must click "Registration" and fill in their details, which will generate their User ID and Password. The User ID will be the Email ID entered at the time of registration. Online application can be done only after successful registration, using the User ID (Email ID). Candidates should keep this User ID/Password safe for future use. After registration, candidates should log in with their registered Email ID and continue the online application process.

Filling the Online Application Form: Candidates first fill in their personal, educational and other required information correctly and completely, then upload a passport-size photo (or capture a live photo through the camera), along with a scanned copy of their signature. Applications sent without a photo and signature will be considered incomplete and rejected. Candidates then click "Save Draft" or "Next".

Attach Annexure: Candidates click "Attach Annexure" and upload scanned copies of their 10th class certificate, certificates related to educational qualification, and other mandatory documents, then click "Save Documents".
Make Payment: Candidates click "Make Payment" and pay the online fee.

Submit: After paying the fee, candidates click "Submit" to complete the application process. The full Application Form will then be displayed on screen; candidates should take a printout and keep it safe for future reference. The Application Form is accepted only after successful payment of the fee.

A saved draft application can be viewed and completed again via "Menu > View Status of Application > View Incomplete Application". Once an Application Form is submitted, it cannot be modified under any circumstances, and no request/demand from a candidate for a future modification will be accepted by the office. If an online fee payment transaction fails for any reason, the candidate's application will be considered not submitted, and the fee already paid will be non-refundable. Applications or fees sent/deposited through any other method will not be considered valid and will be rejected.
important_instructions: Candidates should carefully fill their category and category code in the online form, as this cannot be changed at any stage after the form is filled. The benefit of reservation is available only to residents of Punjab. Candidates must keep this in mind while filling category and category code; eligibility will be considered only on the basis of the category and category code entered in the online form. To claim reservation, every candidate (male or female), regardless of category, must upload/produce a Domicile Certificate/Residence Certificate not more than 5 years old at the time of upload/production. The Scheduled Caste certificate must be as per prevailing Punjab Government instructions. Women candidates will be given the benefit of reservation as per the Punjab Government notification titled "The Punjab Civil Services (Reservation of Posts for Women) Rules, 2020", No. G.S.R. 87/Const/Art.309 and 15/2020 dated 21/10/2020, and amendments issued from time to time. Instructions issued by the Punjab Government from time to time will apply to candidates belonging to denotified tribes (Vimukt Jati). Candidates must produce valid certificates related to their category at the time of counseling and at any other stage as required by the Board. In the absence of any required document at the time of counseling, the candidate will not be considered for the posts, and the next eligible candidate on the merit list will be recommended to the concerned department instead. Merit for candidates in the sportsperson category will be decided as per the notification dated 09.03.2026 issued by the Department of Sports, Punjab, and instructions issued from time to time. For Legal Assistant posts, department preference from candidates will be taken at a later stage.

content_sections.heading: SSSB Punjab Recruitment 2026 – Quick Summary
content_sections.text: Who is recruiting? Subordinate Services Selection Board, Punjab (SSSB), on behalf of various Punjab Government departments. Which posts? Head Draftsman, Law Officer, Legal Assistant (Directorate of Higher Education), Accountant (Excise and Taxation Department), and Legal Assistant (Punjab Water Supply and Sewerage Board). How many vacancies? 10 (General-7, SC (Mazhabi and Balmiki)-1, SC (Ramdasia and others)-2; 2 of the 10 posts are reserved for women). Who can apply? Candidates who meet the post-specific educational/technical qualification below, are residents of Punjab for reservation benefit, and meet the age limit as on 01.01.2026. Application start date: 01-10-2026. Last date: 22-10-2026 (for both submitting the online application and paying the fee). Application mode: Online only, through https://sssb.punjab.gov.in. Job location: Punjab (various department offices, as named against each post).

content_sections.heading: SSSB Punjab Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: SSSB has notified 10 vacancies across 5 posts. Category-wise numbers are as per demand letters received from the departments concerned and may be increased, decreased, or withdrawn by the department at any stage of the recruitment process; such changes will apply to all candidates. Of the 10 posts, 2 are reserved for women (per the notification's women column): 1 under General category (Accountant) and 1 under SC (Mazhabi & Balmiki) (Accountant). SC (M&B) means Scheduled Caste (Mazhabi and Balmiki); SC (R&O) means Scheduled Caste (Ramdasia and others).

content_sections.text: The qualification required for each post, as per the demand received from the concerned department, is given below. Per Punjab Government notification No. G.S.R.7/Const./Art.309/Amd.(23)/2026 dated 21.01.2026, the candidate must fulfil the required educational qualifications before the last date for online application: "The cut-off date to determine the minimum educational and other qualifications, unless otherwise specifically provided in the relevant rules, shall be the last date for submission of application forms."

content_sections.heading: SSSB Punjab Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates who successfully apply for the notified posts will be called for an Objective Type (Multiple Choice Question, MCQ) written examination. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the written examination. There will be negative marking in this written examination: each question carries 1 mark, and ¼ mark will be deducted for a wrong answer. In case of a tie in merit in the written examination: first, the candidate with the higher age (based on date of birth) will rank above; if the date of birth is also the same, the candidate with a higher percentage in the required educational qualification will rank above; if this is also tied, the candidate with higher marks in Matriculation will rank above. Based on the merit list, candidates will be called for counseling for verification of all documents. The number of candidates called for counseling will be decided by the Board or its competent authority/officer, keeping in view the category-wise number of vacancies. After counseling, the names of candidates found completely successful/eligible will be recommended to the concerned department as per the then-current number of vacancies (which may be reduced or increased at any time during the recruitment process as per the concerned department's orders/instructions). Applying online, appearing in the written exam, having one's name in the merit list, or being called for counseling does not by itself entitle a candidate to be recommended for a post. Only after the candidate's eligibility is proved in every respect will their name be recommended to the department on the basis of merit in the written examination. If a candidate is unable to prove their eligibility, their candidature will be cancelled, and the Board's decision in this regard will be final. Candidates called for counseling will be considered only under the category/post code against which they applied.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Punjab Subordinate Services Selection Board (Punjab SSSB) for various administrative and technical positions across the state.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced under Advt 13 of 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies have been announced for posts including Head Draftsman, Law Officer, Legal Assistant, and Accountant under this notification cycle.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 1 October 2026 and the last date to submit the application form along with fee payment is 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 37 years of age. Category-based relaxations are applicable for SC candidates of Punjab, government employees, and eligible women candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Accountant post must possess a Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) degree along with a 120-hour computer course or DOEACC 'C' Level certification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for general category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for all other categories except Scheduled Castes of Punjab is Rs. 1500/-, while SC candidates of Punjab need to pay Rs. 750/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary scale for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a basic pay of Rs. 35,400 under Level-6 pay scale, with certain legal posts offering corresponding state salary structures.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Punjab SSSB recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an Objective Type Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) Written Examination featuring negative marking, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. How can eligible candidates apply for these vacancies?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website sssb.punjab.gov.in, completing the registration, filling out the form, and paying the fee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can access and download the official notification PDF directly from the important links section provided within this recruitment notification article.
